citation.authors: Fatemeh G, Sajjad M, Niloufar R, Neda S

cited_by.title: Melatonin for sleep: what it does, dose and rules by country

record.population: Adults with various conditions in 23 randomised trials
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of melatonin and sleep quality on the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index
record.finding: Melatonin improved Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index scores by 1.24 points (95% CI 0.71 to 1.77), with large differences between studies (I2 80.7 per cent). Gains were larger in people with respiratory diseases and metabolic disorders than in people with sleep disorders (0.67 points).
record.note: Disagrees in tone with Choi 2022. Self-rated sleep quality in mixed groups.
